scope: Targeted primary-literature scan; principal practical families and combinations, not an exhaustive list of all possible reward formulas.

reward_families.source_summary: Pay only for a successful sit and hold. Simple target, but early learning can receive little guidance.
reward_families.application_proposed: Keep a clear completion bonus. Sparse reward alone is unlikely to fix rare landing slips.

reward_families.source_summary: Add small rewards for useful posture/contact and penalties for slip, hard impact and effort. Weights can create unwanted tradeoffs.
reward_families.application_proposed: Retain completion dominance. Make worsening slip distinguishable after crossing the threshold; do not let effort savings compensate contact failures.

reward_families.source_summary: Reward improvement toward a goal rather than merely remaining near it. Potential-based shaping preserves optimal policies under its stated assumptions.
reward_families.application_proposed: Use progress toward legal supported rest; define terminal potentials correctly. This does not guarantee fast learning with our neural policy.

reward_families.source_summary: Give different guidance for approaching, making contact and settling. Only enable comfort/effort rewards when the relevant contact conditions hold.
reward_families.application_proposed: A phase-aware approach/contact/hold objective is a substantive alternative to one global weighted sum.

reward_families.source_summary: Reward matching successful example poses, velocities and contacts. Hierarchies can combine reusable example motions.
reward_families.application_proposed: Provide successful sitting/leaning examples, retargeted to this robot. Fixed-frame tracking can constrain adaptation to new surfaces.

reward_families.source_summary: A discriminator learns what plausible scene interactions look like; combine this with task completion.
reward_families.application_proposed: Use diverse contact-aware examples to guide exploration. Style does not itself certify no slipping or forbidden contacts.

reward_families.source_summary: Optimize task reward while explicitly constraining harmful outcomes instead of mixing everything into one score.
reward_families.application_proposed: Treat protected-case retention as an explicit evaluation requirement. Expected-cost constraints are not guarantees for every individual case.

reward_families.source_summary: Give more importance to rare bad outcomes or the poorly performing tail instead of only the average.
reward_families.application_proposed: Prioritize recurring failure conditions and measure worst-case retention. Tail estimates require sufficient samples.

reward_families.source_summary: Learn a reward from people comparing short behavior clips.
reward_families.application_proposed: Useful for comfort/naturalness or acceptable settling. Keep measured safety checks separate; tiny slips can be invisible to people.

reward_families.source_summary: Search over reward programs using measured training performance and feedback.
reward_families.application_proposed: Use a bounded, reproducible search with independent selection criteria. It consumes experiments and can exploit poorly specified metrics; not an automatic fix.

reward_families.source_summary: Express different desired outcomes as goals; replay achieved goals to learn from unsuccessful attempts.
reward_families.application_proposed: Potentially useful across seats and support locations, but standard HER needs an off-policy learner. It is not a drop-in addition to the current PPO update.

current_problem: Reference-assisted residual PPO can adjust three symmetric pitch channels by at most0.004rad (~0.23deg), with0.004rad/s slew. It is learning small corrections to a preset low-seat sitting controller. This comparison does not validate general leaning.

evidence_vs_hypothesis.measured: Revised seed63111 checkpoint64:59/72 strict clean,70stable,13slipping,2forbidden contacts. Eight original failures and five regressions.
evidence_vs_hypothesis.local_optimum: Possible but unproven; plateau and failures alone do not establish local optimality.
evidence_vs_hypothesis.PPO_unsuitable: Not established. PhysHSI uses PPO for humanoid interaction, with substantially different action freedom, data and training design.
evidence_vs_hypothesis.earlier_causal_explanation: Training coverage, exploration/evaluation mismatch and flat severity shaping are supported concerns, not experimentally isolated causes.

criteria.strict_score: 1 only if stable completion, no physical failure, zero slip_ticks and zero illegal_ticks;0otherwise.
criteria.slip_fail: loaded contact tangential speed >0.02m/s at any20ms sample
criteria.qualifying_hold_limits: root speed <=0.10m/s;angular speed <=0.25rad/s;trunk tilt <=40deg;friction utilization <=0.90;legal contacts,joint margin,latched alive required.
criteria.physical_failures: fall(root height<0.28m or tilt>55deg),forbidden contact(wrong contact force>10N or active contact outside permitted patch),torque limit,impact>2bodyweights,joint-limit margin violation.

perfectionism: The current metric is stricter than a visual successful-sit judgment: a single20ms slip fails the entire trial. Preserve the declared metric, but report stable completion, slip severity/duration, and forbidden contacts separately. Whether brief controlled settling should be acceptable is a task-definition decision, not a reward hack.

closest_robotics_example.success_definition: Base within0.1m of target with heading aligned; paper specifies15degree angular tolerance.
closest_robotics_example.method: PPO with task,regularization and learned motion-style rewards;29joint outputs.
closest_robotics_example.comparison_limit: Different robot/task/distribution and success criteria; cannot compare its90% directly with our81.9%strict score.

next_step_recommendation: First compare retention-aware sampling across all72development cases against current sampling at matched total budget.
Then test one smooth slip-severity reward ablation while preserving clean-success ranking.

If unchanged failures persist, review the3-channel residual controller and frozen reference; consider demonstration-guided,stage-conditioned control rather than endless weight tuning. A different controller requires a separately specified and authorized experiment.
